title: Camera battery and memory card taken from locked locker

tellings.quote: And the battery is missing and the memory card is missing.

plain: In 2009, on a ship at Subic Bay in the Philippines, someone took the battery and the memory card from a camera that was stored in a locked locker. Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a huge craft, about 300 feet across, in the Indonesian jungle, tells this as something that happened to him: he went to the camera and "the battery is missing and the memory card is missing." If it is true, someone wanted to make sure no pictures were kept.
